Indian Head Rail Trail Extension
Feasibility Study

Crossing of the Short Line Trail at Bloomsbury Avenue.
Charles County will analyze the feasibility of extending the
Indian Head Rail Trail to the Three Notch Trail in St. Mary's
County. This feasibility study is the initial step in connecting

the two main trails in Southern Maryland.
The City of Salisbury is expanding the city's bicycle network
along Isabella Avenue, Lake Street and Small Street with a

series of protected bike lanes and bicycle boxes.
The City of Takoma Park will further the design of the New
Hampshire Avenue Bikeway section between Auburn Avenue
and Poplar Avenue.

Frederick County is initiating the design of a two-mile-long,
shared-use path along an abandoned railroad corridor

between Monocacy Boulevard in Frederick and Fountain Rock
Park in Walkersville.
